title: Cohen-Macaulay morphisms of algebraic spaces tested on etale charts and at points via strict local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces criterion for the Cohen-Macaulay property: the lemma gives three equivalent chartwise conditions using surjective etale charts by schemes, and separately a pointwise equivalence comparing the strict local rings of a point and its image. The proof establishes the equivalence of the chartwise conditions using that the property descends along surjective etale morphisms, and then the pointwise criterion by passing to the strict local rings and applying the scheme case there. The chart descent together with the strict-local-ring comparison is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 6240-6263 statement, proof 6265-6308.
